title: Profile the WebGL renderer on the OTC Conference Center model
description: Loads the OTC Conference Center as XGF, slowly orbits the camera to keep the renderer busy, and captures 60 frames of per-bin GPU + CPU time via RenderInspector.captureFrames. Captures twice: once at the canvas's natural size, then with the canvas resized to 32x32 px. If GPU time barely changes between the two runs, the workload is not fragment-bound and LOD work will not pay off; a steep drop at 32x32 means it is fragment-bound and LOD is the right next bet. Results are printed to the devtools console as two console.table blocks plus the GL renderer string.
